ALL_MATTERS_EVENT_WHEEL_OF_CHANGE.title: Wheel of Change
You encounter a sharply dressed, grinning gremlin.
‘It’s time to spin the wheel! [b]Are you ready?[/b] Of course you are!’
The pointer stops on [blue]Remove a Card[/blue].
Remove one removable card from your deck.
There are no eligible Common or Uncommon relics left. The spin ends without a reward or another spin.
There are no removable cards in your deck. The spin ends without removing a card or another spin.
The wheel falls still. Your fate is settled.
ALL_MATTERS_EVENT_CLERIC.title: Cleric
ALL_MATTERS_EVENT_CLERIC.pages.INITIAL.d:
A strange blue humanoid in a golden helmet smiles widely.
"[jitter]Hello friend![/jitter] I am [blue]Cleric[/blue]! Want to try my services?"
ALL_MATTERS_EVENT_CLERIC.pages.INITIAL.o: Lose [red]{PurifyCost}[/red] [gold]Gold[/gold]. Remove a card from your [gold]deck[/gold].
ALL_MATTERS_EVENT_CLERIC.pages.HEAL.desc: A warm golden light surrounds you and fades.
ALL_MATTERS_EVENT_CLERIC.pages.PURIFY.de: Cold blue flame surrounds you and fades.
ALL_MATTERS_EVENT_CLERIC.pages.LEAVE.des: You decide not to trust this [blue]"Cleric"[/blue].
ALL_MATTERS_EVENT_OLD_BEGGAR.title: Old Beggar
ALL_MATTERS_EVENT_OLD_BEGGAR.pages.INITI:
A ragged old beggar reaches toward you as you pass.
"Spare some change, child?"
Lose [red]{GoldCost}[/red] [gold]Gold[/gold]. Remove a card from your deck.
ALL_MATTERS_EVENT_OLD_BEGGAR.pages.GAVE_:
The beggar suddenly drops his cloak, revealing [blue]Cleric[/blue]!

"You are a kind soul. Receive my purification!" he shouts.

You are not sure whether he is happy or angry.

"May you do better this time, friend!" he calls after you.
Remove a card from your deck.
ALL_MATTERS_EVENT_OLD_BEGGAR.pages.REMOV: You keep walking, turning his strange words over in your mind.
ALL_MATTERS_EVENT_OLD_BEGGAR.pages.LEAVE:
The beggar lowers his head as you pass, muttering:
"You will never accomplish anything... never."
ALL_MATTERS_EVENT_THE_DIVINE_FOUNTAIN.pa: You find a fountain set into the wall. [blue][sine]Glowing water[/sine][/blue] flows endlessly from it.
Remove all removable [red]Curses[/red] from your deck.
The [blue][sine]water[/sine][/blue] washes away the [purple]dark weight[/purple] in your deck.
You leave the strange fountain behind.
ALL_MATTERS_EVENT_AUGMENTER.title: Augmenter
ALL_MATTERS_EVENT_AUGMENTER.pages.INITIA: A suspicious man offers you a dangerous experiment.
Transform [blue]2[/blue] cards, then [gold]Upgrade[/gold] the resulting cards.
Lose your original starting relic. Obtain [gold]Mutagenic Strength[/gold].
ALL_MATTERS_EVENT_AUGMENTER.pages.JAX.de: He hands you a syringe full of [blue][sine]glowing fluid[/sine][/blue].
ALL_MATTERS_EVENT_AUGMENTER.pages.TRANSF: You wake up later. Your deck has changed.
Choose 2 cards to transform and upgrade.
ALL_MATTERS_EVENT_CURSED_TOME.title: Cursed Tome
ALL_MATTERS_EVENT_CURSED_TOME.pages.INIT: An ominous tome lies open on a pedestal. Its pages seem to beckon.
ALL_MATTERS_EVENT_CURSED_TOME.pages.PAGE: You begin to read. A sharp pain accompanies the turning page.
The words draw you deeper. You must keep reading.
The last passage is almost within reach.
ALL_MATTERS_EVENT_CURSED_TOME.pages.LAST: You reach the end. Will you pay the price to claim a book?
ALL_MATTERS_EVENT_CURSED_TOME.pages.CHOO: The price is paid. Choose one of the three books.
ALL_MATTERS_EVENT_CURSED_TOME.pages.OBTA: You take your chosen book and leave the others behind.
ALL_MATTERS_EVENT_CURSED_TOME.pages.STOP: You close the tome, paying one last painful price.
ALL_MATTERS_EVENT_CURSED_TOME.pages.DEAD: The tome claims your life. You receive no book.
ALL_MATTERS_EVENT_CURSED_TOME.pages.LAST: Lose [red]15[/red] HP. If you survive, choose one book.
Lose [red]3[/red] HP. Leave without a book.
You find a tomb dedicated to a red mask.
You put on the Red Mask. A mechanism opens, spilling gold at your feet.
You offer 150 Gold. The Red Mask falls gently into your hands.
You decide not to disturb the tomb.
ALL_MATTERS_EVENT_THE_LIBRARY.title: The Library
ALL_MATTERS_EVENT_THE_LIBRARY.pages.INIT:
You pass an abandoned, magnificent building.
A sign has fallen from the wall. It reads [b]“The (Unmoving) Great Library.”[/b]
Inside, you find countless scrolls, manuscripts, and books.
You pick up a book and settle into a comfortable armchair to read.
Choose one of 20 cards from other characters to add to your deck.
No eligible cards from other characters.
Obtain a random Bottled Flame, Bottled Lightning, or Bottled Tornado.
No unowned bottle has an eligible card to bind.
ALL_MATTERS_EVENT_THE_LIBRARY.pages.READ: Choose a card to add to your deck.
The book tells of a shrine maiden and a magician who fought side by side to end a scarlet mist that shrouded the land. Its many imaginative accounts of supernatural powers captivate you.
The book tells of a group of youkai who set out to mend the imperfect moon. They resolved a misunderstanding with strangers from the moon, and the full moon was restored.
The book tells of a magician who sensed a disturbance underground. With help from humans and youkai, she ventured deep beneath the earth and defeated a crow youkai.
ALL_MATTERS_EVENT_THE_LIBRARY.pages.SLEE:
Perhaps you have been reading for too long.

You doze off in the armchair.
[b]Zzz...zzz.....Zz....[/b]
You wake up feeling refreshed.
ALL_MATTERS_EVENT_THE_LIBRARY.pages.CLEA:
Perhaps this place has not been cleaned in over a hundred years.

You tidy up the area and uncover a strange bottle among the clutter.
